# Amberly Digital

> Custom AI Agents, Voice Intelligence, and Enterprise Workflow Automations built for scaling companies.

## Overview
Amberly Digital is an AI software development agency specializing in custom LLM fine-tuning, RAG knowledge retrieval systems, voice AI receptionists, and enterprise workflow automations.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [AI Automation & Integration](https://amberlydigital.com/services/ai-automation-integration): Workflow automations connecting CRMs, ERPs, databases, and scheduling platforms.
- [Voice Agents & Telephony](https://amberlydigital.com/services/ai-receptionist): 24/7 AI Receptionists handling inbound phone calls, lead qualification, and calendar bookings.
- [AI Image Generation](https://amberlydigital.com/services/ai-image-gen): Custom AI image generation and marketing visual assets studio.
- [AI Video Generation](https://amberlydigital.com/services/ai-video-gen): Automated video creation and promotional media tools.
- [Startup MVP Development](https://amberlydigital.com/services/startup-mvp-development): Rapid 2–4 week AI product prototypes for startups and founders.
- [SaaS Product Architecture](https://amberlydigital.com/services/saas-product-development): Multi-tenant scalable web platforms and custom AI backends.

## Key Principles & Guarantees
- **100% IP Ownership**: Clients retain full ownership of all source code, IP rights, fine-tuned models, and infrastructure.
- **Private Data Security**: Enterprise data is stored securely and never used to train public LLM models.
- **Rapid Sprints**: Most AI solutions ship in 2 to 4 weeks with working prototypes delivered in week one.
- **Build Before You Buy**: Try live AI demos and interactive prototypes before making any financial commitment.
